chinese: 在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该生物。
english: Sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.

chinese: 本场对局已获胜。队伍{1, WinningTeamId}赢得本场对局{2, select, =0 {.} =1 {3, select, =0 {，因为对方队伍已用尽时间。} =1 {，因为对方队伍闲置过久。}}}
english: The match has ended in victory. Team {1, WinningTeamId} has won the match{2, select, =0 {.} =1 {3, select, =0 { because the opposing team ran out of time.} =1 { because the opposing team was inactive for too long.}}}

chinese: 从CARDNAME上移去一个<nobr>+1/+1</nobr>指示物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。
english: Remove a <nobr>+1/+1</nobr> counter from CARDNAME: It deals 1 damage to any target.

chinese: 困于狮眼中 ～赛费尔谚语，意指「陷入危急时刻」
english: Held in the lion's eye —Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

chinese: 重置目标由你操控的永久物。
横置目标由对手操控的永久物。
english: Tap target permanent an opponent controls.

chinese: 目标牌手弃两张牌。该牌手可以复制此咒语，且可以为该复制品选择新的目标。
english: Target player discards two cards. That player may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.

chinese: {oT}：派出一个衍生物，其为目标由你操控的非传奇生物之复制品，但它具有敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。
english: {oT}: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary creature you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

chinese: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。
english: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

chinese: 领土～由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。
english: Domain — This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each basic land type among lands you control.

chinese: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，该牌手选择目标操控着比其更多生物且为其对手的牌手。前一位牌手可以从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张生物牌为止。如果前一位牌手如此作，则该牌手将该牌放进战场，并将其余以此法展示的牌置入自己的坟墓场。
english: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player chooses target player who controls more creatures than they do and is their opponent. The first player may reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. If the first player does, that player puts that card onto the battlefield and all other cards revealed this way into their graveyard.

chinese: 「身为笨头笨脑、冥顽不灵的基因突变体，他们瞄得倒挺准。」 ～西赛
english: "For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim." —Sisay

chinese: {oT}，牺牲一个树林：加三点法术力，其颜色为{oR}和／或{oG}的任意组合。
english: {oT}, Sacrifice a Forest: Add three mana in any combination of {oR} and/or {oG}.

chinese: 如果歼铁巨像将从任何区域置入坟墓场，则改为展示歼铁巨像并将它洗入其拥有者的牌库。
english: If Blightsteel Colossus would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal Blightsteel Colossus and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.

chinese: 重置目标由你操控的永久物。
横置目标由对手操控的永久物。
english: Tap target permanent an opponent controls.

chinese: 每位牌手各将一张生物牌从自己的坟墓场放进战场。
english: Each player puts a creature card from their graveyard onto the battlefield.

chinese: 秘罗地不常有坏天气，但确实会打雷。
english: Mirrodin has little weather, but it certainly has lightning.

chinese: 每位牌手各将其手牌与坟墓场洗入其牌库。你抓七张牌。
english: Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library. You draw seven cards.

chinese: 大学院研究的主题是时间～直到他们将时间用尽。
english: The academy worked with time—until time ran out.

chinese: 「任何东西都会被吓倒～除了石头。」
每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个词句指示物，然后它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于其上的词句指示物数量。
english: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a verse counter on CARDNAME, then it deals damage equal to the number of verse counters on it to target player or planeswalker.

chinese: 「不需为我哀伤。这是我的宿命。」 ～杰拉尔德
english: "Don't mourn for me. This is my destiny." —Gerrard

chinese: 检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置入你的坟墓场。
english: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your graveyard.

chinese: 由你操控的每个生物，如果是白色便具有警戒，蓝色便具有辟邪，黑色便具有系命，红色便具有先攻，绿色便具有践踏。
english: Each creature you control has vigilance if it's white, hexproof if it's blue, lifelink if it's black, first strike if it's red, and trample if it's green.

chinese: 重置至多一个目标生物和至多一个目标地。
english: Untap up to one target creature and up to one target land.

chinese: 在迷雾草原紧密团结的村落里，责任比死亡更重要。
english: In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.

chinese: 咒语摇摆不定，屡受舌际与意识边缘牵引。
english: The spell wavered, caught on the tip of his tongue and at the edge of his awareness.

chinese: 提灯闪光对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。<s>[X为由你操控的生物数量。]</s>
english: Lantern Flare deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life. <s>[X is the number of creatures you control.]</s>

chinese: 消灭目标<s>[进行攻击的]</s>生物。
将目标<s>[由你操控的]</s>非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。
english: Return target nonland permanent <s>[you control]</s> to its owner's hand.

chinese: 抓三张牌。<s>[于这盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌上限减少三张。]</s>
english: Draw three cards. <s>[Your maximum hand size is reduced by three for the rest of the game.]</s>

chinese: 将目标<s>[狼或狼人]</s>生物移回其拥有者手上。
english: Return target <s>[Wolf or Werewolf]</s> creature to its owner's hand.

chinese: 反击目标咒语<s>[，且该咒语须未从其拥有者手上施放]</s>。
english: Counter target spell <s>[that wasn't cast from its owner's hand]</s>.

chinese: 目标牌手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张<s>[法术力值等于或小于2的]</s>非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。
english: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it <s>[with mana value 2 or less]</s>. That player discards that card.

chinese: CARDNAME对目标<s>[人类]</s>生物造成3点伤害。你获得3点生命。
english: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target <s>[Human]</s> creature. You gain 3 life.

chinese: 寄生之攫对目标<s>[人类]</s>生物造成3点伤害。你获得3点生命。
english: Parasitic Grasp deals 3 damage to target <s>[Human]</s> creature. You gain 3 life.

chinese: 消灭所有<s>[法术力值等于或小于2的]</s>生物。
english: Destroy all creatures <s>[with mana value 2 or less]</s>.

chinese: 于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。于该回合中，伤害不能被防止。<s>[在该回合的结束步骤开始时，你输掉这盘游戏。]</s>
english: Take an extra turn after this one. During that turn, damage can't be prevented. <s>[At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.]</s>

chinese: 从你牌库中搜寻一张<s>[基本地]</s>牌，<s>[展示该牌，]</s>将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。
english: Search your library for a <s>[basic land]</s> card, <s>[reveal it,]</s> put it into your hand, then shuffle.

chinese: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。<s>[X为由你操控的生物数量。]</s>
english: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life. <s>[X is the number of creatures you control.]</s>

chinese: 由对手操控之生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。
english: Damage isn't removed from creatures your opponents control during cleanup steps.

chinese: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林牌，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。
english: Search your library for a Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

chinese: 「在我们奋战时，黜人们却投降了。」 ～维克族神谕使
「我当初怎么会答应参与这计划？」 ～半兽人队长舔牙者哈吉
english: "How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?" —Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

chinese: 「死亡是一个过时的概念。我们只是睡著，然后产生变化。」 ～诞生牧师西垂克
english: "Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change." —Sitrik, birth priest

chinese: 千年历史，全毁于一次年少轻狂的恶作剧。
english: A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

chinese: 你每操控一个<s>[具飞行异能的]</s>生物，便抓一张牌。
english: Draw a card for each creature you control <s>[with flying]</s>.

chinese: {2, plural, =1 {选择{2, Number}个目标由你操控的地。} other {选择{2, Number}个目标由你操控的地。}}
english: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} land you control.} other {Target {2, Number} lands you control.}}

chinese: 生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。
english: Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps.

chinese: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。CARDNAME获得「生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。」
english: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. CARDNAME gains "Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps."

chinese: {oU}，{oT}：从永恒巨著的法术书中将一张随机牌幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: {oU}, {oT}: Conjure a random card from Tome of the Infinite's spellbook into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 每当任一牌手于你的回合中弃一张牌时，其选择另一位牌手。该牌手将该牌的一张副本幻变进其手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: Whenever a player discards a card during your turn, they choose another player. That player conjures a duplicate of that card into their hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 目标对手弃一张牌。然后他可以再弃一张牌。若他未如此作，则将其牌库中随机牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: Target opponent discards a card. Then they may discard an additional card. If they don't, conjure a duplicate of a random card from their library into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: {o2}，{oT}：选择目标对手。将其牌库顶牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。然后该牌手牌面朝下地放逐其牌库顶牌。
english: {o2}, {oT}: Choose target opponent. Conjure a duplicate of the top card of their library into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic. Then they exile the top card of their library face down.

chinese: 将目标在任一对手坟墓场中之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: Conjure a duplicate of target creature card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese:
选择一项<nobr>～</nobr>
•<indent=4%><indent=4%>反击目标非生物咒语。</indent></indent>
•<indent=4%><indent=4%>将目标在任一对手坟墓场中之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。</indent></indent>
english:
Choose one<nobr> —</nobr> 
•<indent=4%><indent=4%>Counter target noncreature spell. </indent></indent>
•<indent=4%><indent=4%>Conjure a duplicate of target creature card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.</indent></indent>

chinese: 将目标非衍生物且非地的永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则将该牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: Return target nontoken, nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, conjure a duplicate of that card into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 将X个目标非衍生物之永久物各自的一张副本幻变进你手上。这些牌永久获得虹彩异能。如果X等于或大于5，则你可以将其中一张从你手上放进战场。
english: Conjure a duplicate of each of X target nontoken permanents into your hand. Those cards perpetually gain prismatic. If X is 5 or more, you may put one of them from your hand onto the battlefield.

chinese: 当此生物精进时，将目标以此生物放逐之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。该副本永久获得虹彩异能。如果它的法术力值等于或小于3，则你可以将它放进战场。
english: When this creature specializes, conjure a duplicate of target creature card exiled with this creature into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gains prismatic. If it has mana value 3 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield.

chinese: 当此生物精进时，从以此生物放逐的牌之中选择至多一张目标生物牌和至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌。将这些牌各自的一张副本幻变进你手上。这些副本永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When this creature specializes, choose up to one target creature card and up to one target instant or sorcery card from among cards exiled with this creature. Conjure a duplicate of each of those cards into your hand. The duplicates perpetually gain prismatic.

chinese: 当此生物精进时，将目标以此生物放逐之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。该副本永久得<nobr>+1/+0</nobr>且获得敏捷与虹彩异能。
english: When this creature specializes, conjure a duplicate of target creature card exiled with this creature into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gets <nobr>+1/+0</nobr> and gains haste and prismatic.

chinese: 当此生物精进时，将目标以此生物放逐之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。该副本永久得<nobr>+2/+2</nobr>且获得虹彩异能。
english: When this creature specializes, conjure a duplicate of target creature card exiled with this creature into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gets <nobr>+2/+2</nobr> and gains prismatic.

chinese: SPLICED_TEXT 你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。该生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该生物。
english: SPLICED_TEXT You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.

chinese: 每位牌手弃掉其手牌，然后将其右手边牌手的牌库中七张随机牌各自的一张副本幻变进其手上。这些副本永久获得虹彩异能。
english: Each player discards their hand, then conjures a duplicate of each of seven random cards from the library of the player to their right into their hand. The duplicates perpetually gain prismatic.

chinese: 此生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。
english: Damage isn't removed from this creature during cleanup steps.

chinese: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。如果CARDNAME已乘驾且以此法对某生物造成过伤害，则该生物永久获得「此生物不能进行阻挡」和「此生物上的伤害于清除步骤中不会移除。」
english: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to any target. If CARDNAME is saddled and a creature was dealt damage this way, that creature perpetually gains "This creature can't block" and "Damage isn't removed from this creature during cleanup steps."

chinese: 每当此生物攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为此生物的力量。
english: Whenever this creature attacks, return target nonland permanent card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is this creature's power.

chinese: 指定至多一个由你操控且不是{1, CardId}的生物为目标。
english: Target up to one creature you control other than {1, CardId}.

chinese:
当CARDNAME进场时，选择一项<nobr>～</nobr>
•<indent=4%>重置目标由你操控的永久物。</indent>
•<indent=4%>横置目标由对手操控的永久物。</indent>
english:
When CARDNAME enters, choose one<nobr> —</nobr> 
•<indent=4%>Untap target permanent you control. </indent>
•<indent=4%>Tap target permanent an opponent controls.</indent>

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手牌，且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。
english: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card.

chinese: 当惩戒天使进场时，你可以放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到惩戒天使离开战场为止。
english: When Angel of Sanctions enters, you may exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until Angel of Sanctions leaves the battlefield.

chinese: 「依尼翠的尸鬼牧者算是有点天分，但我要你瞧瞧拥有真正力量者能造出什么来。」 ～莉莲娜维斯
english: "Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create." —Liliana Vess

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，每位对手各获得10点生命。
english: When CARDNAME enters, each opponent gains 10 life.

chinese: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一位牌手。
english: As CARDNAME enters, choose a player.

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，将对手牌库中随机生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a duplicate of a random creature card from an opponent's library into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，从恶兆旅人的法术书中抽选一张牌。该牌永久获得虹彩异能与「当你施放此咒语时，将一个由你操控且名称为恶兆旅人的生物移回其拥有者手上。」
english: When CARDNAME enters, draft a card from Ominous Traveler's spellbook. That card perpetually gains prismatic and "When you cast this spell, return a creature named Ominous Traveler you control to its owner's hand."

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标咒语的一张副本幻变进你手上。该牌永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a duplicate of target spell into your hand. That card perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 当此生物精进时，将目标以此生物放逐之生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。该副本永久获得虹彩异能与「当此生物进场时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。」
english: When this creature specializes, conjure a duplicate of target creature card exiled with this creature into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gains prismatic and "When this creature enters, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life."

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则将目标在任一对手坟墓场中之牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When CARDNAME enters, return target card from your graveyard to your hand. If this spell was kicked, conjure a duplicate of target card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 当CARDNAME进场时，将目标由对手操控且力量小于CARDNAME力量的生物移回其拥有者手上。如果该生物不是衍生物，则将它的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When CARDNAME enters, return target creature an opponent controls with power less than CARDNAME's power to its owner's hand. If that creature wasn't a token, conjure a duplicate of it into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 当你使用另一个地时，牺牲CARDNAME。
english: When you play another land, sacrifice CARDNAME.

chinese: 是某个狮群的长老，也是另一个狮群的印记阶成员。
english: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

chinese: 当伊埃多的沃娜进场时，消灭目标由对手操控之非地且非衍生物的永久物。然后你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将该永久物的一张副本幻变进你手上，且该副本永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When Vona de Iedo enters, destroy target nonland, nontoken permanent an opponent controls. Then you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of that permanent into your hand, and the duplicate perpetually gains prismatic.

chinese: 当此生物进场或精进时，将任一对手牌库中随机生物牌的一张副本幻变进你手上。它永久获得虹彩异能。
english: When this creature enters or specializes, conjure a duplicate of a random creature card from an opponent's library into your hand. It perpetually gains prismatic.
I've Come Up with a New Recipe!

chinese: 从此生物上移去一个<nobr>+1/+1</nobr>指示物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。
english: Remove a <nobr>+1/+1</nobr> counter from this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target.

chinese: 当此生物进场时，目标力量等于或小于此生物力量的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

chinese: 在本周的众神节庆中，我们共同来尊崇熔煅神。发挥你的工匠精神，仅利用「普通」和「非普通」稀有度的卡牌打造出一副符合标准赛制规则的套牌，向不信者宣泄狂怒火雨，令普罗烽斯傲视群神！ 禁用以下牌张： 执着诉愿人 鼎镬佣兽 灾祸行进 城门失火 <#ff1d1d>普罗烽斯主管熔炉、不羁大地、烈火、创新和热忱，同时还能影响创造与毁灭的循环。他手握铸造神锤，用力敲击便能熔毁大地，并利用迸发火花创造生命。
english: Honor the God of the Forge in this week's Festival of the Gods event by fashioning an Artisan-style Standard deck consisting only of common and uncommon cards. The following cards are banned: Persistent Petitioners Cauldron Familiar Cavalcade of Calamity Gates Ablaze <#ff1d1d>Purphoros's areas of influence include the forge, the restless earth, fire, artisans, obsession, and the cycle of creation and destruction. With his mighty hammer, he can melt the earth with a strike and create life from the sparks themselves.

chinese: 在本周的众神节庆中，迈出殿堂，与猎神倪勒娅一同狩猎。你每使用一张费用为4或更高的生物牌，便能够抓一张牌，藉此良机掌控自然之力，放出麾下威凛巨兽踏平对手一切！ 禁用以下牌张： 揭帷娜尔施 倪勒娅不需要殿堂、建物或圣迹来供人尊崇，她更希望这些地方能保留原本的绿水青山与自然生态，受如云般蝶群环绕的树木才是她真正的圣地。她的人类信徒多是独行侠或离群者。她主管四季、森林和狩猎；但她痛恨将此作为享乐运动。
english: Leave your temples behind and join the hunt with the God Nylea in this week's Festival of the Gods event. Harness the power of nature by drawing a card every time you play a creature card with cost 4 or greater, and release your giant monsters to stomp your opponent's units into the ground! The following card is banned: Narset, Parter of Veils Nylea has no temples, buildings, or holy sites in her honor save for trees surrounded by clouds of butterflies. Most of her human followers are loners and outcasts. She has influence over the seasons, the forest, and the hunt; though hates doing so for sport.

chinese: 在本周的众神节庆中，冥界之神厄睿柏斯召唤阴影中的勇士起身再战。构组一副史迹争锋套牌复活鲜活过往，然后派出心腹指挥官，让敌人感受厄运与不幸。 禁用以下牌张： 扰咒法师 窃冠瓯柯 不倦朝圣械戈罗斯 巫视望远镜 <#a95eff>厄睿柏斯是一位嫉妒心极重的暴君，由于所有往生者都是他的「子民」，他也颇以自己的伟业为傲。他司管死亡、冥界、嫉妒、苦痛和财富～因为在冥界当中，黄金唾手可得却又不值一文。
english: Erebos, God of the Underworld is calling forth his champions from the shadows to rise again in this week's Festival of the Gods event! Reanimate the past by building a historic brawl deck and then deploy misfortune and ill fate on your enemies under the leadership of your chosen commander. The following cards are banned: Meddling Mage Oko, Thief of Crowns Golos, Tireless Pilgrim Sorcerous Spyglass <#a95eff>Erebos is a jealous and tyrannical ruler, proud of his domain as lord of all that ever lived. His areas of influence include death, the Underworld, envy, bitterness, and wealth, as gold is abundant and without value in the Underworld.

chinese: 破晓曙光宣告本周的众神节庆正式展开，塞洛斯太阳神赫利欧德的光辉比以往都更耀眼。每位牌手都具有一个具有永生圣阳效应的徽记，并以六张手牌起手。你会如何盖过对手的光芒？ 禁用以下牌张： 莽撞仙灵 揭帷娜尔施 伊雷岩烈焰术士 俄佐立变节者拉温妮 奇诡搭配 由于双方都会具有永生圣阳的效应，因此本活动禁用所有仅具有忠诚异能的鹏洛客。 <#fed100>通常人们在清晨起身用餐或是处理家族荣誉、法律流程、婚礼仪式等事务时都会召唤赫利欧德来见证。他司管太阳、法律、正义、亲缘和报应。飞马通常被视作他的象征。
english: Daylight is breaking on this week's Festival of the Gods event and the radiant glory of Theros' God of the Sun, Heliod is burning brighter than ever. Each player has an emblem with the effects of The Immortal Sun and starts with only six cards. How will you outshine your opponent? The following cards are banned: Faerie Vandal Narset, Parter of Veils Irencrag Pyromancer Lavinia, Azorius Renegade Improbable Alliance Due to the effects of The Immortal Sun emblem, Planeswalkers with only loyalty abilities are banned in this event. <#fed100>Heliod is often invoked at dawn meals and in matters of family honor, legal proceedings, and marriages to name a few. His areas of influence include the sun, law, justice, kinship, and retribution. He is occasionally symbolized by a pegasus.

chinese: 深洋在呼唤！在本周的众神节庆中扬帆起航，探索隐藏秘密和远古知识。你和对手都会掌控一副构成相同、张数超出平常数量的无双套牌。正如远洋水手口号中祈祷的那样：「愿深洋海神塔萨显灵，指引你穿越冰冷洋流，直取最终胜利！」 <#4ffff5>塔萨司掌广阔海洋、水生生物、远古知识和时间流逝等事务。她颇有耐心，坚定地以不可阻挡之势来改变世界现状：重塑大地、改变湾岸、颠覆传统。

english: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Tarkir: Dragonstorm Bot Draft: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection. Mardu Mobilize Create additional tokens to help aid in your attack. Go Wide Tokens Blitz by your opponent with sheer numbers. Use Mobilize tokens and Flurry rewards to build impressive battlefields. Jeskai Flurry Cast two (or more!) spells in a single turn to overwhelm your opponent. Two Spells Use Harmonize spells frequently in order to reap the rewards from Flurry. Temur Harmonize Cast your spells twice with help of your biggest creatures. Leaves the Graveyard Fill up your graveyard, then use Mobilize or Renew and others to get bonuses for cards leaving your graveyard. Sultai Renew Use the power of the graveyard to make your creatures stronger. Counters Use counters of any kind, not just +1/+1 counters, to make your creatures impressive in combat. Abzan Endure Your creatures are versatile! Outsize your opponents with +1/+1 counters or outflank them with spirit tokens. SacrificeSacrifice your extra creatures, such as your temporary creatures from Horde to get extra use out of those creatures.

english: With the 2027 rotation in early February, Alchemy will be retired from MTG Arena. Here's what that means for you: What happens to the cards Digital-only Alchemy cards stay on Arena and remain legal in Historic, Timeless, Brawl, and Competitive Brawl. We may still ban or rebalance them as we manage those formats in the future. Rebalanced versions of Tabletop cards are a different story though. On September 22, over 200 of Tabletop cards will revert to their original printings across all formats, with ban list updates for Historic and Brawl. Historic * Galvanic Discharge is banned. * Guide of Souls is banned. * Nadu, Winged Wisdom is banned. * Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord is banned. * The One Ring is banned. Timeless * No Changes Brawl * Nadu, Winged Wisdom is banned Competitive Brawl * No Changes Key dates September 22 — Rebalanced Tabletop cards revert to their original printings. New Bans take effect. October 13 — The final Alchemy set, Alchemy: Reality Fracture, releases alongside sendoff events including a pre-constructed deck event featuring every Into the Future deck. February 2 — Alchemy leaves Arena with the 2027 rotation. This includes the removal of Alchemy Play, Ladder, Constructed events, Direct Challenge, and the Best-of-Three versions of each. We're sending Alchemy off with a celebration over the coming weeks. Twenty expansions in, we learned a lot and we're excited to show you where Arena's formats go next. Thanks for coming along on the journey. Read the full State of the Formats article for the complete breakdown.

chinese: 复仇与毁灭自阿耶尼身上汹涌而出。为了向害死他兄弟的人复仇，他在逆声宇宙中一路留下血腥的痕迹。当塑理师着手打造他的「完美现实」时，阿耶尼向任何挡路的人与物挥出利爪。
english: Vengeance and destruction flow from Ajani. He carved a trail of carnage through the Echoverse seeking revenge against those responsible for his brother's death. As the Theorist crafts his "perfect reality," Ajani lashes out at anyone and anything that stands in the way.

chinese: 茜卓纳拉沉稳、冷静而精于算计。她在凛寒法术上的造诣与在执政院中的步步高升，正是她父亲悉心教导与她本人严格自律的明证。塑理师给了她一个机会，去创造一个没有苦难与纷争的阿维什卡，而她接受了。
english: Chandra Nalaar is measured, calm, and calculating. Her cryomancy prowess and ascendence through the Consulate is a testament to her father's guiding influence and her rigorous self-discipline. The Theorist offered her the chance to create an Avishkar without suffering or strife, and she took it.

chinese: 贾路不只是猎人，更是能召唤凶暴掠食者随他征战的召兽使。为了增强自身力量，贾路求取了锁链面纱——一件蕴含邪恶缚魂魔法的神器。如今他被塑理师当作刺客，派往逆声宇宙各处。
english: More than a hunter, Garruk is a summoner of vicious predators that follow him into battle. Intent on enhancing his strength, Garruk sought out the Chain Veil, an artifact of evil soul-binding magic. He's been deployed across the Echoverse by the Theorist as an assassin.

chinese: 莉莲娜在宾纳里亚以治疗者的身份崭露头角，隶属于名为「前锋团」的僧侣团体。治疗之力让她数百年来青春永驻、长生不死，而她自以为是地笃信着为达目的可以不择手段。
english: Liliana rose to prominence as a healer in Benalia, belonging to a convocation of clerics known as the Forward Order. Her healing powers have kept her youthful and alive for hundreds of years, and she's a self-righteous believer in the ends justifying the means.

chinese: 厄琉斯是嚎勒船长麾下身手敏捷的脊索人拖底手，曾在吉拉波大奖赛中飞驰天际。他来自一个海洋世界，并向阿维什卡当地人吹嘘自己出身皇族，但这并非事实。
english: The nimble Arius, a chordatan Keelhauler from Captain Howler's crew, rocketed through the skies during the Ghirapur Grand Prix. He hails from an oceanic world and boasts to Avishkar's locals that he is descended from royalty, which he is not.

chinese: 走私海盗船长格鲁夏原本在多明纳里亚过了一生，随后遭遇个人悲剧，又经历克撒引爆金杯。兄弟之战后，格鲁夏以波勒瓦之名闻名，成为强大的鹏洛客及九泰坦成员。
english: The smuggler pirate Captain Crucias lived an entire life on Dominaria before personal tragedy struck, followed by Urza's detonation of the Sylex. In the aftermath of the Brothers' War, Crucias became known as Bo Levar, a powerful Planeswalker and a member of the Nine Titans.

chinese: 艾德嘉马可夫不懈追寻永生，为此与恶魔达成交易，与他的孙子索霖一同成为依尼翠的吸血鬼始祖，最终活过了七千余年。他被吸血鬼奥莉薇亚沃达连卷入一场阴谋，被迫与索霖展开激烈对抗。
english: Tirelessly searching for immortality, Edgar Markov struck a demonic bargain, becoming a progenitor vampire on Innistrad along with his grandson, Sorin, ultimately living over 7000 years. He was drawn into a scheme by the vampire Olivia Voldaren, forcing a violent confrontation with Sorin.

chinese: 若能自由选择，埃菲宁愿埋首书卷或钻研技术，但在宅邸中求生迫使她走上了另一条道路——暴力。
english: Left to her own devices, Effie would love to spend her time immersed in books or tinkering with technology, but survival in the House forced her to follow a different path—violence.

chinese: 依莲达是依夏兰吸血鬼的始祖，其力量来自蝙蝠神阿洛佐兹。返回故乡托雷佐后，她将这份恩赐分享给大陆的贵族与神职人员，缔造出狂热的亡者军队——暮影军团。
english: Elenda is Ixalan's progenitor vampire, receiving her powers from the bat-god Aclazotz. Returning home to Torrezon, Elenda shared her gift with the continent's nobility and clergy, creating the Legion of Dusk—a fervent army of the undead.

chinese: 身为葛温普时，他只是个不起眼的普通波尬。但以羊场大盗的身份，他便能实施筹划数月的狡猾大计——偷走一只山羊。牧羊人至今还没发现。
english: As Gwump, he was an ordinary boggart who amounted to little. But as the Grand Goatnapper, he was free to enact his devious master plan, which was months in the making—the theft of a single goat. The herder has yet to notice.

chinese: 阿布赞最精锐的战士是雅善会战士，而哈姆札正是其中力量的巅峰。他是一名克鲁玛，即在阿布赞战争中成为孤儿、后被氏族收养且平等对待的孩子。收养他的芬札拉家族是显赫的统治家族。
english: The Abzan's most elite fighters are the Yathan, and Hamza stands as a pinnacle of their strength. Hamza is a krumar, an orphan of Abzan warfare adopted into the clan and treated as an equal. Hamza's adoptive family is Fenzala, a ruling house of prominence.

chinese: 杰斯在冥想境中似乎已然殒命，自那之后，他的心智便碎裂了。其中一片名为「塑理师」的人格取得了主导权，将他的共情与睿智尽数封锁。如今他高踞于自己所造新现实的王座之上，心中最恶劣的冲动只会愈发膨胀。
english: Jace's mind fractured after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm. A slice of his personality called "the Theorist" has taken over, locking away his empathy and wisdom. His worst impulses have only been magnified as he sits atop the throne of his new reality.

chinese: 大法师裘达生于兄弟之战后数个世纪，是克撒与萼城的凯拉的直系后裔。他在多明纳里亚度过漫长一生，钻研并实践着强大的秘奥法术。他长生不老的秘诀？偶然发现了青春之泉罢了。
english: Born a direct descendant of Urza and Kayla bin-Kroog in the centuries after the Brothers' War, the archmage Jodah spent his long lifetime on Dominaria studying and practicing powerful arcane sorcery. His secret to eternal life? Accidentally discovering the Fountain of Youth.

chinese: 造妖奥葛聪明而善良，在依尼翠的死灵炼金实验室中为基拉夫和卢德维不停工作。他鲜少得到赞许，却会在主人离开时秘密进行自己的研究，例如创造新的活化血肉形态。
english: Clever and well-intentioned, Oglor the homunculus works tirelessly for Geralf and Ludevic in Innistrad's necro-alchemical labs. He rarely receives praise for his efforts, but when his masters are away, he secretly pursues projects of his own—like the creation of new forms of animated flesh.

chinese: 钟表匠拉斯科在萼城打造奇妙装置，吸引了年轻的克撒，并收他为学徒。但随着克撒的天赋和政治势力增长，拉斯科很快便黯然失色。
english: The clockmaker Rusko built wondrous contraptions in the city of Kroog, drawing the interest and apprenticeship of a young Urza. He would quickly be overshadowed by Urza's rising talent and political power.

chinese: 谭姆是杰斯贝连凭意念造出的生命，也是斯翠海文的学生。她忠实地追随着自己的创造者与导师，充当他在多重宇宙中的密探与代理人。但在协助杰斯搜集稳定新现实所需的最后几块拼图时，她开始质疑他的手段。
english: A being thought into existence by Jace Beleren, Strixhaven student Tam dutifully followed her creator and mentor, acting as his spy and agent in the Multiverse. But while helping Jace gather the final pieces to stabilize his new reality, she's begun to question his methods.

chinese: 杰斯贝连是多重宇宙中最强大的心灵法师之一。在非瑞克西亚大侵攻中幸存后，杰斯立誓要改写多重宇宙，让那些暴行从未发生。
english: Jace Beleren is one of the most powerful mind-mage in the Multiverse. After surviving the Phyrexian Invasion, Jace vowed to rewrite the Multiverse so that no atrocities had ever come to pass.

chinese: 魔法学院赫克海文坐落于杰斯的阿凯维沃。斯翠海文兼容并蓄地欢迎各种魔法流派，赫克海文却与之不同，它是一所严苛的学院，只为将学生锤炼成久经沙场的战法师。
english: Hexhaven is the magical academy on Jace's Arcavios. Unlike Strixhaven, which welcomes diverse practices of magic, Hexhaven is a grueling academy that trains its students solely to become hardened battle mages.

chinese: 展鉴是未来历史学院，他们相信最理想的未来可以预知。展鉴的学生立志成为战略家与先知，预见未来，进而操纵并重塑历史的走向。
english: Fatehold is the school of Future History, believing that an optimal future can be divined. Students of Fatehold train to become strategists and prophets who can predict the future to then manipulate and reshape the course of history.

chinese: 论析是秘奥数学学院。论析的学生致力于掌控现实本身，以扭曲心智的方程式将物理法则与世界的本质玩弄于股掌之间。
english: Theorix is the school of Esoteric Mathematics. Students of Theorix train to harness control over reality itself, using mindbending equations to twist physics and the nature of the world to their command.

chinese: 棘毫是伤痛言辞学院。棘毫的学生是以尖刻话语击垮敌人的大师，也常以决斗来磨砺自身技艺。
english: Stingerquill is the school of Painful Words. The students of Stingerquill are masters of tearing down their enemies with a cutting phrase, and often engage in duels to hone their skills.

chinese: 铸丽是构筑艺术学院。铸丽的学生专注于匠艺、建造以及赋生傀儡兽。他们的组构体守护着阿凯维沃的大部分疆域。
english: Konstrari is the school of Constructive Arts. Students of Konstrari are devoted to the craft or building and animating oversized puppetbeasts. Their constructs defend much of Arcavios.

chinese: 愈华是侵入治疗学院。愈华的学生学习以植物诊断病症、治愈创伤，以确保身边众人长寿而充满活力。
english: Vigorbloom is the school of Invasive Healing. Students of Vigorbloom learn to diagnose ailments and heal wounds with plant matter to help ensure the longevity and vitality of those around them.

chinese: 谭姆是杰斯创造的人造人，她驾驭悖论魔法来改写概率、扭曲现实。她曾全心相信杰斯覆写多重宇宙的计划，如今却已心生疑虑。
english: Tam, an artificial person created by Jace, wields paradox magic to rewrite probability and warp reality. She once fully believed in Jace's plan to overwrite the Multiverse, though she now has her doubts.

chinese: 在杰斯那个阿凯维沃，最宏大的地脉之上矗立着塑理师之塔——一座以不可能的方式建成、又被杰斯扭曲现实的魔法进一步拧曲的高塔。他的圣所就在塔的最顶端，让他得以在相对的宁静中观察并操纵这个时空。
english: On the largest leyline of Jace's Arcavios lies the Theorist's Tower – an impossibly constructed tower twisted even further by Jace's reality-bending magic. His sanctum is at the very top, where he can observe and manipulate the plane in relative peace.

chinese: 杰斯的逆声宇宙中存在着许多熟悉的面孔——但因为从未经历本尊所面对的种种考验，他们已成长得几乎面目全非。茜卓是精于算计的凛寒术士，莉莲娜是自以为是的治疗者，而阿耶尼则是一心复仇的凶暴战士。
english: Many familiar faces exist in Jace's Echoverse – but because they never faced the trials of their original selves, they grew to be nearly unrecognizable. Chandra is a calculating cryomancer, Liliana is a self-righteous healer, and Ajani is a ferocious warrior bent on revenge.

chinese: 选择一个生物来攻击。你需要对对手造成伤害才能赢得游戏。
english: Select a creature to attack. You need to deal damage to your opponent to win the game.

chinese: 点选一个生物来攻击。你需要对对手造成伤害才能赢得游戏。
english: Tap a creature to attack. You need to deal damage to your opponent to win the game.

chinese: 若要阻挡，选择你的一个生物，或将其拖向一个攻击生物。
english: To block, select or drag one of your creatures into an attacker.

chinese: 选择下方按钮确认阻挡。
english: Confirm your blocks by selecting the button below.

chinese: 一个咒语让此生物暂时变得更强了！
english: A spell has made this creature temporarily more powerful!

chinese: 无论防御力多少，生物都能挡住全部伤害。
english: No matter its toughness, a creature will block all damage.

chinese: 将法术牌拖到战场上来施放它。 报仇 是法术咒语。
english: Cast a sorcery spell by dragging it onto the battlefield. Take Vengeance is a sorcery spell.

chinese: 对对手造成伤害以赢得游戏。用所有生物攻击。
english: Deal damage to your opponent to win the game. Attack with all your creatures.

chinese: 选择对手已横置的生物。\n\n以蓝色高亮显示
english: Select the tapped opponent creature.\n\nHighlighted in blue

chinese: 点击对手已横置的生物。\n\n以蓝色高亮显示
english: Click on the tapped opponent creature.\n\nHighlighted in blue

chinese: 以对手已横置的生物为目标。\n\n以蓝色高亮显示
english: Target the tapped opponent creature.\n\nHighlighted in blue

chinese: 将法术牌拖到战场上来施放它。 眩目辉芒 是法术咒语。
english: Cast a sorcery spell by dragging it onto the battlefield. Blinding Radiance is a sorcery spell.

chinese: 如果对手能用更强的生物阻挡，就不要攻击，否则你的生物可能死亡。
english: Don't attack if an opponent can block with a more powerful creature. That could kill your creature.

chinese: 将生物牌拖到战场上来施放它。\n\n祭祠守卫是生物
english: Cast a creature by dragging it onto the battlefield.\n\nShrine Keeper is a creature

chinese: 将生物牌拖到战场上来施放它。 破阵象族 是生物
english: Cast a creature by dragging it onto the battlefield. Loxodon Line Breaker is a creature

chinese: 当你操控更强的生物时，用它阻挡攻击者。
english: Block an attacker whenever you control a stronger creature.

chinese: 尽量多阻挡攻击者，保持较高的生命值总是好事！
english: Block more attackers. It's good to keep your life total high if you can!

chinese: 施放灵气咒语，让你的生物更强。
english: Cast an aura spell to make your creatures more powerful.

chinese: 选择每一个你希望用来攻击的生物。已横置的生物不能阻挡。
english: Select each creature you want to attack. Tapped creatures can't block.

chinese: 选择“不攻击”，留一个生物进行阻挡。
english: Select 'No Attacks' to keep back a blocker.

chinese: 若要阻挡，先选择你的一个生物，再选择一个攻击生物。
english: To block, select one of your creatures, then select an attacking creature.

chinese: 增强你的生物，让它更容易在战斗中取胜。
english: Make your creature more powerful to help it win combat.

chinese: 选择你的生物作为目标。
english: Select your creature to target it.

english: Direct text messages in MTG Arena are powered by Discord. These messages may also be viewed within Discord.

english: Invalid Display Name. Please check your spelling and try again.

chinese: 在下方输入好友的显示名称。
english: Input your friend's display name below.

chinese: 通过代码发送牌桌邀请
english: Send invite to Table via Code

chinese: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！每周尝试不同的竞技场玩法！ 本周活动是跳入斯翠海文的秘密！从最新系列的多种主题中选择两副半套牌，将它们组合成一副随时可玩的套牌。与常规“跳入”不同，本活动中的卡牌不会加入收藏。
english: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Jump into Secrets of Strixhaven! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes from the latest set. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.

english: By clicking on ‘Submit' I agree to the Terms and Conditions, Code of Conduct, and Privacy Policy.
